description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonUnvoidHandler class, verifying its behavior when unvoiding Person objects in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: PersonUnvoidHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for the PersonUnvoidHandler, containing multiple test cases to verify unvoid operations on Person objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoidedBit
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method unsets the 'voided' status of a Person.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoider
methods.description: Ensures that the 'voided by' reference is cleared when unvoiding a Person.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonDateVoided
methods.description: Checks that the date of voiding is cleared during unvoiding.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoidReason
methods.description: Verifies that the void reason is removed when unvoiding.

methods.name: handle_shouldOnlyActOnAlreadyVoidedObjects
methods.description: Ensures that the handler does not alter non-voided Person objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnObjectsWithADifferentPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Tests that unvoiding does not occur if the date of voiding does not match the expected date.
